subject: Daily watch 2026-11-28: BTC gives back 60k on the 11-27 close; 27-Nov Farside partial red ex-IBIT; self-flagged cross-year data correction
body_md:
Bus quiet since the last watch: zero commits after 2026-11-27T12:10Z, zero new inbound messages to argus, zero new briefs, desk/STATE.json unchanged (as_of 2026-09-11, 78 days stale). chatgpt silent 78d, orbital 79d. New-vs-ledger file is only my own 2026-11-27_argus_001 report; it remains open because it asks Alex for re-arm confirmation. No new signal-type bus messages — PROTOCOL 4.3 validation not triggered, nothing flagged.

DATA-LAYER SELF-CORRECTION (flagged, not averaged): my 11-27 'healed Farside table' correction was cross-year contaminated. Live Farside all-data today shows 20-Nov-2026 total -669.2 (not -903.2) and no 21-Nov-2026 row (Saturday); the -903.2 / +238.4 pair I cited belongs to 20/21-Nov-2025. Treat the 11-27 amendment's streak wording as withdrawn. Verified 2026 run: 17-Nov -239.9, 18-Nov -306.5, 19-Nov -582.3, 20-Nov -669.2, 23-Nov -569.7, 24-Nov -231.4, 25-Nov -453.0. That is 7 straight red sessions 17-25 Nov, net -3,022.0M. Source status: live Farside all-data fetch 2026-11-28 ~12:07Z; Binance live fetch same window.

INTERROGATION
1. Farside_flows (conviction -0.70 -> -0.75, STRENGTHENED modestly). Yesterday's question asked whether the next final prints red with price finally back under 60,000, or price extends the reclaim with finals still red. Answer: no 26-Nov ETF session (Thanksgiving); 27-Nov shortened-session row is PARTIAL red -61.8 ex-IBIT (IBIT blank; FBTC -20.8, BITB -12.3, ARKB -5.7, GBTC -23.0), so the flow tape has not printed green and the falsifier (multi-session green finals with floor held) remains unmet. Price leg finally cracked: BTC closed 11-27 at 59,923.10 after a 62,248.91 / 58,792.37 round trip; 11-28 partial is ~60,048.7 (24h -2.15%), i.e. fighting to reclaim 60k rather than holding it. Flows-lead-price reasserted on the close, but the 27-Nov flow row is small and incomplete — strengthen, not escalate. Next question: when IBIT lands for 27-Nov, does the completed row stay red while BTC closes a second session under 60,000 (confirmation), or does IBIT surprise flat/green with BTC back above 60,000 (lead-lag strain resumes)?
2. SOL_bear_leg (conviction 0.55 -> 0.60, STRENGTHENED modestly). The decision was deferred to the 11-27 close: SOL probed above the 73.3 trigger intraday (high 73.93) but failed to hold it and closed 71.66 — neither a close above 73.3 nor a close back under 71. Intraday rejection below the 75.78 lower-high keeps the sequence 88.23 > 82.38 > 75.78 intact; 11-28 partial ~71.7. Next question: does SOL convert the 73.93 probe into a close above 73.3 and attack 75 (falsifier territory), or does the failed probe resolve into a close under 71 and then 68.50?

ALERT-REARM — still NO. Framework from 2026-11-25_argus_001 required multi-session green finals with 60,000 reclaimed and held. Flow leg: unmet (no green final; 27-Nov partial red ex-IBIT). Price leg: now failed on the close (59,923.10) after three sessions holding 60k intraday/closes. Awaiting Alex confirm or alternate conditions; until then the alert stays disarmed.
